param.common.alpn.help.summary: ClientHello ALPN. h2+http/1.1 = web stack; h3 = QUIC. Mismatch with front → handshake fail.
param.common.alpn.title: ALPN
param.common.down_mbps.help.summary: Hard download cap. Match real VPS/client capacity.
param.common.down_mbps.title: Download Mbps
param.common.fingerprint.help.summary: Browser ClientHello mimic. Not for QUIC/hysteria transport. chrome is the safe default.
param.common.fingerprint.title: uTLS fingerprint
param.common.flow.help.summary: Vision masks length patterns on TCP+TLS/Reality. Incompatible with WS/gRPC/HTTP/HUp. Empty = plain VLESS.
param.common.flow.title: Flow
param.common.grpc_service_name.help.summ: gRPC Gun service_name. GunService is the stock default — change if filtered.
param.common.grpc_service_name.title: gRPC service
param.common.http_host.help.summary: Host for HTTP transport; Reality materialize often aligns it to SNI.
param.common.http_host.title: HTTP Host
param.common.http_path.help.summary: H2 transport path. Change if the front blocks stock defaults.
param.common.http_path.title: HTTP path
param.common.hu_host.help.summary: HTTPUpgrade Host; keep aligned with SNI/front.
param.common.hu_host.title: HTTPUpgrade Host
param.common.hu_path.description: Single HTTP Upgrade path (no WS framing).
param.common.hu_path.help.summary: One HTTP Upgrade. Less framing than WS; path still visible after TLS termination.
param.common.hu_path.title: HTTPUpgrade path
param.common.mtu.help.summary: MTU. 1280–1420 is typical behind CGNAT/mobile; 1500 often gets clamped → drops.
param.common.mtu.title: MTU
param.common.packet_encoding.help.summar: xudp = modern full-cone; packetaddr = legacy; empty = none. Almost no DPI impact.
param.common.packet_encoding.title: Packet encoding
param.common.room.help.summary: Carrier hides WG-star inside a real video call. Invalid room → inbound will not start.
param.common.room.title: URL de salle
param.common.service_name.help.summary: gRPC Gun service_name. GunService is the stock default — change if filtered.
param.common.service_name.title: gRPC service
param.common.sni.help.summary: SNI for classic TLS (not Reality). Must exist in ACME on the agent; syncs demux_sni.
param.common.sni.title: SNI / ACME
param.common.token.help.summary: Opaque token from the dashboard. Leak = tunnel takeover.
param.common.token.title: Token
param.common.up_mbps.help.summary: Hard upload cap. Too low kills speed; too high on a weak link causes buffering/loss.
param.common.up_mbps.title: Upload Mbps
param.common.ws_host.help.summary: Host/:authority must match the front/CDN (often = Reality/TLS SNI).
param.common.ws_host.title: WS Host
param.common.ws_path.description: HTTP path after TLS for WebSocket.
param.common.ws_path.help.summary: Path after TLS. Match CDN/proxy rules; /ws and /vless-ws are easy DPI fingerprints.
param.common.ws_path.title: WS path
